quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: R&D spending RMB 777,643,427.06, up 72.88%, 4.03% of revenue (none capitalised); R&D staff 1,751 (up 28.56%); 87 R&D projects, including next-generation AI computer PCB process technology, high-end intelligent server compute boards, server OAM switch module boards, optical transmission module boards, cloud data-center switch boards, server PCIe accelerator card boards, DDR6 dual-channel graphics memory boards and MRDIMM memory module boards. The company says it can make PCBs of more than 100 layers, was among the first globally to mass-produce 6-step 24-layer HDI, has 10-step 30-layer and 16-layer any-layer HDI capability and is advancing R&D certification of next-generation 14-step 36-layer HDI; it says its AI accelerator card and AI data center UBB and switch board market share leads globally.

quarterly_data.quarter: Victory Giant Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report, 2026 business plan (company guidance): focus on high-end AI, automotive electronics and high-speed transmission toward its 2030 output value target; deepen strategic cooperation with technology giants and expand supply of core products such as GPU accelerator cards and TPU supporting boards; concentrate R&D on ultra-high-order HDI and ultra-high-layer-count boards, signal integrity and thermal performance for high-end AI servers and GPUs; integrate the Thailand and Vietnam bases and accelerate Southeast Asian capacity (Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia) as a second growth curve. The company states the plan is an internal operating target, not a profit forecast, and its achievement is uncertain.
